name: Based Farttorney
source:
You farded.

That's it. That's the whole game.

Protect yourself and your dignity, and don't get kicked out of the bar for unleashing one of the stankiest and wettest farts known to man. 

Lucky for you, you're an attorney, which means you're used to bullshitting your way out of things. 

And you're not just any attorney - you're the most BASED Attorney who's ever Attorney-ed. 

You're the man, the myth, the legend - Ron Ansar himself. 

So get out there and defend your honor!

It's Attorney-ing time!

[From [url=https://elseth.itch.io/based-farttorney]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你放了个屁。

没错，整个游戏讲的就是这么回事。

拼死捍卫你自己与你的尊严吧，千万别因为放出了人类史上最臭不可闻、最潮乎乎的一记响屁而被轰出酒吧大门。

好在你可是一名大律师，最擅长的本事就是靠满嘴跑火车把黑的说成白的、全身而退。

而且你绝非等闲之辈——你可是有史以来最牛逼轰轰的王牌大律师！

你就是那个男人、那段神话、那个不朽传奇——罗恩·安萨尔本尊。

所以挺身而出，誓死捍卫你的名誉吧！

开庭辩护时间到！

[摘自[url=https://elseth.itch.io/based-farttorney]itch.io[/url]]
